model.name: pin.liveUpdateNoRefresh
model.description: When an owner designates a task as CURRENT/NEXT, the sprint pin updates LIVE with NO page refresh @390 (Tron's AC: 'actions should happen LIVE in the tree'). CONSUMER WIRING over the pre-existing T103 ViewBus: the NOTIFY (handlePinDesignate, PRIMARY) fires ViewBus.notify on the CurrentSprint singleton's OWN ref after a 200 designate; the RECEIVER (RbTraceTree.connectedCallback subscribe-wiring) re-fetches ONLY the 2-node pin -> the tree updates live without flooding. NOT a ViewBus method (does not ride emitUnitChanged db4008d9 — that is the generic emit; these are CALLS to T103 subscribe/notify).
